description: Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011, Rule 13, Seventh Schedule, Heading A ('Specifications for Non-Automatic Weighing Instruments'). Every value below is traced in docs/research/heading-a-verified.md to a line of docs/research/heading-a-raw.txt, re-derived independently from the raw legal text rather than copied from OIML_R76_2006.json. AoM Rule 7(1)(a) permits a report to conform to either this profile or OIML R 76 — see docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §8 for the points where the two profiles genuinely diverge (they are not just relabelled copies of each other).
mpe_clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A §3(6)(i) (Table 20), with §3(4) for multi-interval instruments
classification_clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A, Table 17 (§3(3)(i)) — verified identical to OIML Table 3, see docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §1
mpe_in_service_clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A §3(6)(ii) — 'the maximum permissible errors during inspection shall be twice the maximum permissible errors allowed on verification' (India calls the in-service stage 'inspection'; see docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §3)
multi_interval_boundary_clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A, Table 18 (§3(4)(iii)) — verified identical to OIML Table 4, see docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §4
rounding_elimination_clause: Not located verbatim in Heading A (searched exhaustively — see docs/research/heading-a-verified.md, 'could not be verified either way'). Heading A §9(1)'s worked error formula (P = I + 1/2e - dL) is stated unconditionally, without OIML R 76-1 §3.5.3.2's explicit d > 0.2e gate. Kept at the same numeric value pending a primary-source citation; do not treat this clause string as a verified Indian citation.

notes.family_solver: Omitted. Heading A has no provisions corresponding to OIML R 76-1 §3.10.4 (family/EUT selection) — grepping the raw text for 'family'/'variant' returns zero hits, and Heading A never mentions OIML or R 76 (no incorporation by reference). A lab evaluating a family of variants under the India profile has no textual basis in Heading A for a reduced test set; use the OIML profile for that determination (AoM Rule 7(1)(a)). See docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §8c.
notes.module_error_fractions: Omitted for the same reason as family_solver — no Annex-F-equivalent module-compatibility text exists in Heading A. See docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §8c.
notes.checklist_rules: Omitted. Heading A has zero occurrences of 'software' and no 17.1-17.4 numbering; it carries R 76-1-style substantive requirements (direct-sales requirements at Heading A §4(14)-(15), interface/software integrity at §4(3)(vi)) but never packages them as a discrete, numbered checklist the way OIML R 76-2 §17 does. Adding checklist_rules under invented Indian clause numbers would violate 'never invent a clause number'. See docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §8d.
notes.disturbances_road_vehicle: Omitted from tests[]. Heading A's Annexure A §3 disturbance sub-tests (short-time power reductions, burst, ESD, radiated-EM immunity) have no fifth entry for road-vehicle supply transients (OIML R 76-2 form 12.7). See docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §7/§8d.

discrimination.note: Heading A §3(8)(i) uses the FULL mpe as the extra load for non-self-indicating instruments, cross-referencing the minimum-sensitivity movement criterion of §6(1) — not OIML §3.8.1's 0.4x|mpe| 'visible displacement' criterion. This is a verified, deliberate difference from OIML_R76_2006.json (non_self_extra_load_fraction: 0.4) — see docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §8a. Do not reconcile the two packs to the same number.

creep.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A §3(9)(iv)(a); test procedure at §9(9)
creep.note: The narrative test procedure at §9(9) (raw text line ~1249) prints 'the difference between 15 and 30 minutes is less than 2 deg C', which is almost certainly OCR corruption of '0.2e' — the numerically load-bearing statement at §3(9)(iv)(a) is unambiguous and is what this rule pack uses. See docs/research/heading-a-verified.md.

zero_return.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A §3(9)(iv)(b); test procedure at §9(10)
zero_return.note: On a multi-interval instrument the limit is 0.5 x e1, and a multiple-range instrument carries an additional check of a full e1 over 5 minutes after switching down from a load above Max1 — identical to OIML §3.9.4.2.

span_stability.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A, Annexure A, para 4

significant_fault.note: A fault of exactly e is permitted; only a fault greater than e is significant. The same four exclusions as OIML apply (simultaneous independent causes, impossibility to measure, obviously wrong, transitory).

tests.title: Temperature effect on no-load indication
tests.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A §3(9)(ii)(c), Annexure A §2(1)

tests.title: Discrimination
tests.note: Heading A carries no 'd >= 5 mg' exemption for digital-indication discrimination (verified absence — OIML §3.8.2.2 has this exemption, Heading A §3(8)(ii)(b) does not); this test therefore applies unconditionally, unlike OIML_R76_2006.json's 'not: { digital_d_lt_5mg: true }'. See docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §8b.

tests.title: Repeatability
tests.extra: In addition to |Ec| <= mpe per row, the spread across repeated weighings must satisfy Emax - Emin <= |mpe| (Heading A §3(7)(i), identical to OIML §3.6.1). The spread check is not covered by any of the five kernels.

tests.title: Stability of equilibrium
tests.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A §9(10) (embedded within the zero-return procedure)
tests.note: Not implemented, same as the OIML pack. Its acceptance is not time-based and does not fit K4: a fixed <= 1e check on raw printed or stored readings, plus a zero-setting check against a fixed 0.25e rather than the resolved mpe.

tests.title: Tilting when loaded
tests.note: Loaded tilting applies to both plain class II and class II* (Heading A §11(i)(b): 'class II, II*, III and IIII'). The unloaded check uses a fixed 2e threshold, not the resolved mpe, and does not apply to plain class II — see the separate 'tilting_no_load' test.

tests.title: Tilting at no-load (class II*, III, IIII only)
tests.note: India-specific: verified verbatim at Heading A §11(i)(a) ('Tilting at no-load (class II*, III and IIII)') — plain class II (directSalesToPublic !== true) is excluded from this sub-test, unlike the loaded-tilting test above. Not present in OIML_R76_2006.json; this is Heading A's own class-II* distinction. See docs/research/heading-a-verified.md §6.

tests.title: Electrical disturbances
tests.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A, Annexure A §3 (short-time power reductions, burst, electrostatic discharge, radiated-EM immunity)

tests.title: Damp heat, steady state
tests.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A, Annexure A §2(2)

tests.title: Span stability
tests.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A, Annexure A §4
tests.note: The printed form checks the average error against fixed bands of 0.5e / 1e / 1.5e rather than against a resolved mpe column, same as OIML.

tests.title: Endurance
tests.note: Heading A §9(15) verbatim: 'Applicable only to instruments of class II, III and IIII with Max <= 100kg' — even more explicit than OIML on the class restriction (OIML's is in Annex A.6, not directly under its own §3.9.4.3 sentence).

tests.title: Examination of the construction of the instrument
tests.clause: Seventh Schedule Heading A, paragraph 4 (technical requirements for construction, generally)
tests.note: Heading A has no discrete 'form 16' section; construction requirements are scattered through paragraph 4. Retained for structural parity with the OIML report layout under AoM Rule 7(1)(a).

india_section_mapping.title: Evaluation of error
india_section_mapping.note: Error formula (P = I + 1/2e - dL) used by every K1 form, not a standalone form.

india_section_mapping.title: Weights (standard-weight tolerance)
india_section_mapping.note: Test-equipment requirement, not a report form.

india_section_mapping.title: Weighing test using substitution method
india_section_mapping.note: Alternate method for the same form.

india_section_mapping.title: Zero return test (+ embedded stability-of-equilibrium sub-test)
